meta.description: Applies theory testing and corrective action in troubleshooting.

question.text: After identifying a likely cause of a network fault, which two actions are appropriate parts of testing the theory and resolving the issue? Select two.
options: Test the theory in a controlled way when possible
Plan and implement an appropriate corrective action after confirming the cause
Change several unrelated settings at once without recording them
Skip verification after applying a fix
correctAnswers: Test the theory in a controlled way when possible
Plan and implement an appropriate corrective action after confirming the cause
